Title: Account access and roles
Acceptance Criteria: A registered teacher can sign in/out. Unauthenticated requests receive 401 and a teacher cannot call administrator operations (403). Passwords are never stored in plaintext.

Title: Initial assessment
Acceptance Criteria: A teacher completes 9 original scenario questions, 3 per module, plus separate confidence prompts. Missing mandatory answers prevent submission and receive a field-level error.

Title: Scores and history
Acceptance Criteria: The server stores answers, score, timestamp and content/rule versions. Confidence is displayed separately. A repeated request with the same idempotency key creates one attempt.

Title: Explainable recommendation
Acceptance Criteria: The lowest-scoring incomplete module is recommended; a tied score uses M1, M2, M3 order. The page names the topic and score behind the choice. With no assessment, show the catalogue without a personalised claim.

Title: Three learning modules
Acceptance Criteria: Each published module contains an objective, competence reference, lesson, example, practice brief and completion rules. Unpublished versions are not visible to teachers.

Title: Practical submission
Acceptance Criteria: A teacher saves a text response and an optional HTTPS resource link, then submits. Empty text is rejected; an invalid link does not silently disappear. Drafts remain editable.

Title: Rubric feedback
Acceptance Criteria: An administrator reviews a submitted task using four 0-2 criteria, gives a comment and chooses accepted or revision needed. A teacher can see only their own feedback.

Title: Progress
Acceptance Criteria: The dashboard distinguishes not started, in progress, awaiting review, revision needed and completed. A module completes only after the required lesson steps and an accepted practice submission.

Title: Content administration
Acceptance Criteria: An administrator creates/edits drafts and publishes a new version. Existing attempts retain their original question and rubric version; publish does not rewrite history.

Title: Data control
Acceptance Criteria: A teacher can obtain their own assessment/submission history and request account deletion. The administrator removes associated personal records under the agreed retention process; deletion is logged without retaining the content.

Title: Resume and recover
Acceptance Criteria: A saved draft can be reopened after sign-out. A failed save shows an error, preserves visible text and offers retry without showing a false success.

Title: Pilot export
Acceptance Criteria: An authorised administrator exports pseudonymised, consented pilot records with task/form version, scores, condition and timestamps. Non-consenting accounts are excluded.

Title: Access control
Acceptance Criteria: Integration tests using two teachers and an admin show zero successful cross-user reads/writes. Authorisation is checked on the server for every protected resource.

Title: Accessibility
Acceptance Criteria: Core flows work by keyboard; labels and visible focus exist; errors are associated with fields. Test selected WCAG 2.2 A/AA criteria [R12]; record failures rather than claiming full conformance.

Title: Responsive layout
Acceptance Criteria: Core screens at 360, 768 and 1280 CSS pixels have readable controls and no horizontal page scrolling; test keyboard and zoom behaviour.

Title: Performance target
Acceptance Criteria: On the recorded staging hardware, seed 100 teacher accounts and run 20 concurrent sessions for 5 minutes. Target p95 API response under 1 second and under 1% unexpected failures. Report actual results and exclusions.

Title: Data integrity
Acceptance Criteria: A failed transaction does not produce a completed attempt or duplicated progress. Concurrent/retried submission tests preserve one record per idempotency key.

Title: Reproducibility
Acceptance Criteria: A fresh checkout can be configured with example variables, migrated, seeded with synthetic data and tested using the documented commands; no private data or credentials in Git.

Title: Privacy
Acceptance Criteria: Collect only account and learning data needed for the workflow. Do not collect pupil records; keep contact keys separate from research exports. Agree retention before pilot consent.

Title: Recovery
Acceptance Criteria: Restore a staging backup into an isolated database and verify seeded counts and relationships. Target restoration within 60 minutes; record actual elapsed time.
